title: Normalize Security Events to CIM
objectives: Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: Inspect the three v7_auth events in ops_logs. They use account, src_ip and outcome rather than CIM fields. On sh01, use app v7_cim native props.conf aliases account AS user and src_ip AS src, and EVAL-action=if(outcome="denied","failure","success").

Create eventtypes.conf [v7_authentication] search=sourcetype=v7_auth and tags.conf [eventtype=v7_authentication] authentication=enabled. Restart the virtual sh01 service. Search index=ops_logs tag=authentication action=failure | stats count by user src action, open Job Inspector, and verify alice / 10.0.0.1 / failure / count=2. This is a bounded Authentication normalization exercise, not full CIM certification.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
